name: unit_convert
description: Convert between scientific and engineering units. Supports: temperature (celsius/fahrenheit/kelvin/rankine), length (meter/km/mile/foot/inch/yard/etc), mass (kg/gram/pound/ounce/ton/stone/etc), volume (liter/gallon/quart/pint/cup/ml/etc), speed (m/s/km/h/mph/knot/mach/etc), pressure (pascal/bar/psi/atm/torr/mmHg/etc), energy (joule/calorie/kWh/BTU/eV/etc), power (watt/hp/BTU/h/etc), area (m²/km²/acre/hectare/sq ft/etc), data (byte/KB/MB/GB/bit/etc). Example: Convert 100 celsius to fahrenheit, or 5 miles to kilometers. Always provide value, from_unit, and to_unit.
